privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: How Reader handles sign-in, saved links, extension keys, ChatGPT access, and analytics.
paragraphs: Reader stores your Google sign-in identity and the links you save, including their titles and read states. Older saved material remains stored in your account.
The extension sends the current page’s URL and title only when you click Save link. Its connection key stays in Chrome’s local extension storage. Reader stores a hash of that key.

When you connect ChatGPT through MCP, it can retrieve your links and available source text, and update read states when you ask. Reader may fetch a saved URL to extract text. OpenAI’s privacy terms apply to information shared with ChatGPT.
Reader uses analytics and error monitoring to understand usage and failures. We do not sell your saved links.
Contact the maintainer to request removal of your account data.

faq.title: Reader — questions
faq.description: Reader saves links for use with ChatGPT.
faq.heading: Just your saved links.

questions.question: How do I add one?
questions.answer: Paste a URL in the inbox or click Save link in the Chrome extension.

questions.question: How does ChatGPT use it?
questions.answer: Connect Reader through MCP with OAuth. ChatGPT can search links, retrieve available text, and mark links read when you ask. The connection requires a deployed endpoint and OAuth setup.

questions.question: Where are the other features?
questions.answer: RSS, the reader view, annotations, boards, memories, PDFs, and built-in AI are outside the active product. Existing saved data is retained.

questions.question: Where is the extension?
questions.answer: It is built from this repository and loaded unpacked in Chrome. Public distribution is deferred.

changelog.title: Reader — changes
changelog.heading: A smaller Reader.
paragraphs: The active product is a saved-link inbox, a one-click capture extension, and MCP tools for ChatGPT to retrieve links and update read state.
Existing saved data remains intact. Deployment and an authenticated ChatGPT connection are verified separately from source changes.
